title: The center-left just posted a job opening. The role is socialist hunter, and it pays $15 million.
body: The Lever's Veronica Riccobene and Jonathan Easley found the listing. Third Way, the corporate-backed "centrist" think tank that spends its days pushing Democrats to the right, is hiring a Director for "Anti-Extremism." The job is a takedown of the Democratic Socialists of America. The posting says so plainly. The hire will assemble "a database of the DSA's most extreme ideas and statements," build a "repository of voting records, affiliations, and issue positions," and recruit "a group of young, diverse spokespeople to fight the DSA from a center-left perspective." All of it backed by a fresh $15 million and Third Way's own label for the socialists, "mortal danger."

Now put that against the week's scoreboard. The Lever's "Establishment Strikes Back" roundup and David Sirota, writing in The Intercept, land on the same read. Francesca Hong just lost a tight primary for Wisconsin governor. Moderates are declaring open season. So this isn't a party that thinks the left is finished. You don't stand up a whole department and burn $15 million to bury a movement that's already losing.
Here's the tell. When a "centrist" outfit builds a permanent operation to hunt people inside its own party, the word "extremism" was never the point. The threat it actually fears is losing control.
